import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    b = int(next(it))
    arr = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    val = [-1 if x % 2 == 0 else 1 for x in arr]

    sum_val = 0
    cost = []
    for i in range(n - 1):
        sum_val += val[i]
        if sum_val == 0:
            diff = arr[i+1] - arr[i]
            cost.append(diff if diff >= 0 else -diff)

    cost.sort()
    tcost = 0
    maxp = 0
    for c in cost:
        if tcost + c <= b:
            tcost += c
            maxp += 1
        else:
            break

    print(maxp)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
